purpose: Review official Korean cadastral/parcel map channels for safe anonymous geometry and stable parcel identity.
assessment: K-GeoP is an evidenced official parcel-information map service. Its current viewer and configuration were retrieved, but the declared map WFS host was not resolvable from this host. No geometry or native parcel identity was retained.
registryAssessment: The official national K-GeoP service and Government24 cadastral-map procedure establish a real Korean cadastral service. Cheonan's own official page confirms city land administration/statistics, but it does not expose a public parcel-vector endpoint in this research.
